Name: Combatplus
Author: tzx878787
Description:
[size=5][b]Combatplus – Turn-Based Battles for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

Combatplus transforms Stardew Valley’s real-time combat into a fully featured turn-based RPG battle system.
Every monster encounter becomes a strategic battle where stats, speed, skills, loadouts, and decision-making matter. Build your character, customize your combat style, unlock powerful skill kits, and take on groups of enemies in tactical battles!
Vanilla monsters are fully supported, and Combatplus also includes a fallback conversion system capable of adapting many modded monsters into Combatplus enemies automatically.
Multiplayer compatible.

Uninstall/Install whenever. There should be no issues.
[line]
Features
[heading]Turn-Based Combat System[/heading]
Combat encounters are completely reworked into structured turn-based battles.
[list]
[*]Fight monsters in dedicated battle sequences[/*]
[*]Select actions and targets each turn[/*]
[*]Battle multiple enemies simultaneously[/*]
[*]Supports multiplayer combat encounters[/*]
[*]Tactical gameplay focused on builds and strategy[/*]
[/list]Combat begins whenever:
[list]
[*]You hit a monster[/*]
[*]A monster attacks you[/*]
[/list][line]
